steps.text: Preheat an outdoor grill for high medium-heat and lightly oil the grate.
Whisk butter, garlic, curry powder, cumin, and salt together in a small bowl until well combined. Set aside.

Arrange 4 large sheets aluminum foil on a flat surface. Divide mussels into 4 even portions and place 1 portion in center of each piece of foil. Dot mussels evenly with butter mixture; sprinkle top of each with bell pepper and parsley. Top each with lime slices. Wrap foil tightly around mussels to make 4 packets.
Place the packets on the preheated grill; cook until mussels open, 5 to 10 minutes. Discard any mussels which do not open.
Transfer mussels to small bowls; garnish each with a lime wedge.

raw_recipe.headline: Grilled Mussels with Curry Butter
raw_recipe.description: In this terrific recipe, top mussels with a rich curry butter, seal in foil packets, and grill until done. Serve as an appetizer with crusty bread.

review.reviewBody:
Highly recommended! I have made this several times now over a charcoal grill and it is fantastic. I have also had to share the recipe with my neighbor after he smelled it while it was cooking! I will add that you should soak the mussels before you cook them in order to get the sand out of them:
Place the mussels in a large pot (8qt or so), and for every 24 mussels add 4 cups of cold water and 1/3 cup salt. Stir well once to mix the salt, mussels, and water. After soaking for about 15 or 20 minutes dump the water, rinse the mussels and repeat. Complete the process a total of 3 times.
***
We just made this again tonight (the windchill here in MN was -14, but we really wanted to grill.) We added a bag of bay scallops on top of the mussels and then topped off each individual bowl (when it was finished) with a squeeze of lime, and a sprinkle of garlic salt and curry powder -- WOW! This was amazing! We served it with a baked potato & a salad. Thank you so much for this recipe!

Amazing. Total hit in the house for a Sunday night dinner. A good baguette to sop up juices and a little garlic butter with parsley to go on top made it perfect. Next time I'm going to sauté the peppers with some red onion in curry butter before putting on grill.

I can tell THIS would be my favorite recipe for mussels ever. I wanted to review for one reason: I am a stove-top mussel cooker, and every recipe I see, I make on the stove. If you also would rather make this on the stove top, do NOT add the lime slices. Instead, squeeze some lime juice on right before serving. The boiled lime actually REALLY overpowered everything and gave a bitter aftertaste...I found out the hard way haha!

This recipe was delicious!!! We loved it... I didn't have any parsley or limes, but I did sprinkle with lime juice. I also put scallops in as well and baked it since our bbq in under a snow bank. I recommend trying this, it's easy and so good.

These were absolutely delicious. I loved that these could be made on the grill, 98 degrees outside as I write this. Curry & mussel lovers will be in heaven. I prepared exactly as written. Only thing, I did not care for the added lime slices. Great idea, and pretty presentation, but the rind adds a bitterness that took away from the overall enjoyment of this dish. Next time I will addd lime juice and leave out the wedges during cooking. But great overall, and a definite do-over. Thanks for sharing, Diana.

I just recently started liking mussels and this is the first time I cooked them myself. Super simple recipe. I steamed them instead of grilling them. They were soo tender and juicy and the sauce was perfect!
To us, It seemed to have a bit of lackluster. If I was a chef perhaps I would know how to alter for better flavor.
Everything turned out absolutely delicious. The flavor was spot on. I will definitely be using this recipe again. There wasn't a mussel left in sight.
I didn't change anything except i double the curry butter and throw it in the oven. Im not a fan of mussels but this is soooooo good. Hubby love it too!
The whole family enjoyed this easy, colourful dish. Nice that you can make it ahead.
The first i cooked this recipe is when we visited a friend, i offered and took a risk. But the outcome is amazing, everybody love it. It was one of my best recipe list if i have guests at home.
Wow! Great recipe I added some green onions and cherry tomatoes as extra. Even my five year old loved them. I will be telling friends about this recipe. Thanks
This is a very easy and DELICIOUS way to have mussels. We have never grilled them before but have already made plans for the next time!!!!!!
We love this recipe! We are making it again tonight. This will be our fourth time in five weeks.
